'''Dannar Calwell''', was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] founder of the [[Dannar's Claim]] in the [[Pika Oasis/Legends|Pika Oasis]]. The husband of [[Annileen Calwell]], he was also the father of [[Kallie Calwell|Kallie]] and [[Jabe Calwell]].
